  runValidator(props) {
    if (isStandardSchemaValidator(props.validate)) {
      return standardSchemaValidators[props.type](
        props.value,
        props.validate
      );
    }
    return props.validate(props.value);
  }
}
function normalizeError(rawError) {
  if (rawError) {
    return rawError;
  }
  return void 0;
}
function getErrorMapKey(cause) {
  switch (cause) {
    case "submit":
      return "onSubmit";
    case "blur":
      return "onBlur";
    case "mount":
      return "onMount";
    case "server":
      return "onServer";
    case "dynamic":
      return "onDynamic";
    case "change":
    default:
      return "onChange";
  }
}
export {
  FieldApi
};
